title: Mainsah et al. 2025 — bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset (Study P)
description: Study P of the bigP3BCI collection, an open and machine-learning-ready P300-based brain-computer interface speller dataset. It contains 32-channel EEG recorded over two sessions from 19 participants diagnosed with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), who used a 9x8 character grid with predictive and non-predictive spelling paradigms. Target and non-target flashes are annotated with HED tags to support P300 detection and BCI benchmarking. Note: the auto-generated 'Health status: healthy' line in the README is a template default; the study population is the ALS cohort described in the source bigP3BCI dataset.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) at 256 Hz from 32 channels placed according to the 10-20 system. Participants performed a visual P300 speller task on a 9x8 grid with online feedback in a laboratory. Each participant completed a calibration phase followed by test sessions.
